profile.summary: Information Technology Manager with 25+ years of progressive IT leadership and infrastructure management experience. Specializes in network engineering, systems administration, disaster recovery, and IT operations across complex enterprise environments. Demonstrates strong technical depth in LAN/WAN/WLAN design and optimization, hardware/software lifecycle management, and vendor relations, combined with proven ability to lead teams, drive process improvements, and deliver measurable cost savings and performance gains. Holds dual Master's degrees in Information Systems Management and Leadership, plus industry certifications (MCP, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA A+).
